question: Rachel Kushner novel shortlisted for Booker 2024 is titled:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Creation Lake**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Creation Lake** is a novel by Rachel Kushner, known for her critically acclaimed works that explore themes of art, politics, and human relationships.
 
• The book was **shortlisted for the Booker Prize 2024**, a prestigious literary award recognizing outstanding works of fiction.
 
• Rachel Kushner has been a finalist for the Booker Prize before, showcasing her consistent presence in the literary world.
 
• The Booker Prize highlights novels written in English and published in the UK or Ireland, and Kushner’s work has received international acclaim for its depth and narrative style.
 
• Kushner is also the author of other renowned novels such as **The Flamethrowers** and **The Mars Room**, both of which have earned her critical and literary recognition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Booker Prize:**

 
 
• Founded in 1969, it is one of the most prestigious literary awards in the world.
 
• The prize is awarded annually for the best original novel written in English and published in the UK or Ireland.
 
• It aims to promote the finest in fiction by rewarding exceptional literary works.
 
 
 
• **Rachel Kushner:**
 
 
• An American author noted for her ability to blend history, politics, and personal narratives in her novels.
 
• She has been a finalist for major literary awards, including the National Book Award and the Booker Prize.
 
• Kushner’s writing often draws upon her extensive research and vivid storytelling techniques.
 
 
 
• **Other Works by Kushner:**
 
 
• **The Flamethrowers (2013):** A novel set in the 1970s art scene and Italian political unrest.
 
• **The Mars Room (2018):** A compelling story about life in a women’s prison, which was shortlisted for the Booker Prize.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Booker Shortlisting:**
 
 
• Being shortlisted for the Booker Prize brings global recognition and a significant boost in readership.
 
• It highlights the author’s contribution to contemporary literature and cements their reputation as a literary figure.
